goal: Continuously test and improve the cross-domain stability of multilingual tokenization fairness using legal aligned data, strong controls, verified metrics and retained negative results.

completion_criteria.description: Identify and test mechanisms governing cross-domain fairness transfer with independently checked aligned-token metrics.
Prospectively evaluate justified method revisions against Classical BPE and matched controls while accounting for token cost.
Separate exposed development evidence from genuinely fresh confirmation and expand language/domain coverage only with legal provenance.
